=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18212-18354 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The queue depth (`ACTIONS_QUEUED_TOTAL`) is set only on the loader's fresh-fetch path; the 304 early return at 18313-18336 and the in-TTL memory-cache early return at 18256-18261 leave it empty, so `queue_backpressure_holds_dispatch` takes the `outcome=unknown` branch at 18467-18474 and returns 1 (not held).
  WHY: The 304 is driven by the in-progress read's ETag (18288-18291). In a stuck backlog where nothing is running, the in-progress set does not change, the API returns 304 every tick, the depth is never read, and stall recovery keeps re-dispatching `/answer` or `/approved` into the jammed queue. Source severity was MAJOR. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash noted the same fail-open on the 304 and memory-cache paths as intended behaviour, not a defect. The fail-open is disclosed in agents.d/stuck-backlog-phase3-queue-backpressure.md:5; the coupling to the in-progress ETag is not. The minimal fix is to read the queued depth on 304 ticks too, but that conflicts with the issue's "Do NOT add a new gh call" constraint. If that constraint wins, record this as a known limitation in the PR body.
- .github/workflows/internal-clarify.yml:5 (and internal-plan.yml, internal-implement.yml, workflow-templates/ai-clarify.yml, ai-plan.yml, ai-implement.yml, line 5 in each) | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The `run-name:` opt-out from the `[issue:N]` tag depends on the user-controlled issue title starting with `[E2E `, a prefix nothing reserves, so any issue author can keep their runs untagged.
  WHY: The tagged parse in `build_active_issue_set` requires `display_title == name + " [issue:N]"` (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19026). An `[E2E `-titled issue's runs are therefore never linked and go back to the legacy re-dispatch path. No privilege is gained. tests/test_poll_issue_run_linkage.py:404-410 only asserts that the gate's own titles start with `[E2E `. Source severity was NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
